title: Advances in artificial intelligence for spatial transcriptomics in cancer: Special focus on Yin Yang 1 (YY1) and Raf kinase inhibitor protein (RKIP).
authors: Dommalapati, Lekhya; Guenter, Rachael; Golivi, Yuvasri; Ganji, Swapna Priya; Sandhya, Tatekalva; Nagaraju, Ganji Purnachandra; Saddala, Madhu Sudhana
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Reviews on cancer
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦空间转录组学中AI/ML方法在癌症研究中的应用，虽提及YY1和RKIP，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) plays a pivotal role in cancer research, offering a unique perspective on gene expression within the cancer microenvironment, further revolutionizing our current understanding of the subject. From addressing the limitations of traditional bulk RNA sequencing by preserving spatial context, this review discusses the importance of integrating machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), and statistical methods for interpreting ST data within oncology. Herein, we use examples from studies involving Raf kinase inhibitor protein (RKIP) and Ying Yang 1 (YY1) to illustrate applications for some of the ST techniques discussed. We explore how applying supervised learning techniques, such as Support Vector Machines (SVMs) and Random Forests (RFs), can significantly help further cancer classification and prediction of clinical outcomes and advance personalized medicine. Additionally, exploring unsupervised learning approaches like clustering and dimensionality reduction methods (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP) allows us to see hidden structures in ST data that may be overlooked. This review discusses recent tools and techniques that have been introduced within the last few years, underlining the transformation brought into ST by ML, AI, and statistical methods that provide new insight into oncogenic drivers such as YY1 and RKIP, cancer heterogeneity, and avenues for personalized medicine approaches in cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics, ST）在癌症研究中发挥着关键作用，为癌症微环境中的基因表达提供了独特视角，进一步革新了我们当前对该领域的理解。从通过保留空间背景来弥补传统批量RNA测序的局限性出发，本综述探讨了整合机器学习（machine learning, ML）、人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）和统计方法以解读肿瘤学中ST数据的重要性。在此，我们利用涉及Raf激酶抑制蛋白（Raf kinase inhibitor protein, RKIP）和阴阳1（Ying Yang 1, YY1）的研究实例，来说明所讨论的某些ST技术的应用。我们探索了如何应用监督学习技术，如支持向量机（Support Vector Machines, SVMs）和随机森林（Random Forests, RFs），能显著促进癌症分类、临床结果预测，并推进个性化医学。此外，探索无监督学习方法，如聚类和降维技术（PCA、t-SNE、UMAP），使我们能够看到ST数据中可能被忽视的隐藏结构。本综述讨论了近年内引入的最新工具和技术，强调了ML、AI和统计方法为ST带来的变革，这些方法为致癌驱动因子（如YY1和RKIP）、癌症异质性以及癌症治疗中个性化医学方法的途径提供了新见解。
